ASH_COATED_OSMIUM.name: Calibrated Stitched Bootstrap
ASH_COATED_OSMIUM.formula: B_t, F_t ~ stitched bootstrap(real Round 1 book states, fair-continuity anchored)
notes: ASH uses shorter continuity-aware blocks around a near-stationary anchor with empirical queue-ahead fills
Observed book shapes are re-anchored to stitched fair blocks instead of naively jumping between raw states

INTARIAN_PEPPER_ROOT.name: Calibrated Stitched Bootstrap
INTARIAN_PEPPER_ROOT.formula: B_t, F_t ~ stitched bootstrap(real Round 1 book states, trend-aware block selection)
notes: PEPPER uses longer trend-aware blocks to preserve regime persistence and directional repricing
Trade events remain empirical tick-level arrivals and sizes rather than fabricated hidden bots
